summary: Small struct zero-initializer. First runs the shared GlobalZeroInit_c2a0 fill on the receiver, then explicitly zeroes the first three dword fields at offsets 0x0, 0x4 and 0x8 and returns the receiver pointer. Called from render-UI and mesh vertex/index buffer loader init paths.

operations.description: Call GlobalZeroInit_c2a0 on the receiver to zero-fill the struct from its start.

unresolved: The enclosing struct type is unproven; only that three leading dwords (offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8) are explicitly cleared after the shared zero-fill.
